theorems.name: Submission.br_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_local
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → X ω = Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
